title: Reese Witherspoon sparks backlash with AI comments
body: Reese Witherspoon is going all in on AI - and not everyone is happy about it. The actress, producer and book club founder took to social media to speak out about leaning in to artificial intelligence, rankling some of her followers in the process.

title: AI growth hits a wall as data centre delays create industry bottlenecks
body: Several data centre projects in the US are running behind schedule, threatening the AI expansion plans of multiple companies. These delays have also impacted returns on the massive investments made by AI firms.

title: The Download: bad news for inner Neanderthals, and AI warfare's human illusion
body: There's a theory that many of us have an "inner Neanderthal." The idea is that Homo sapiens and a cousin species once bred, leaving some people today with a trace of Neanderthal DNA.

title: Anthropic's Mythos AI model could expose trading data, warns US financial group
body: Anthropic's Mythos AI model has triggered fresh concerns after the American Securities Association (ASA) flagged the possibility of misuse involving the market-tracking infrastructure overseen by the US Securities and Exchange Commission.

title: Where manufacturers are succeeding with AI
body: MaintainX reports manufacturers can succeed with AI by starting small, leveraging CMMS data, and defining clear, measurable goals.
